prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: single standalone cassette for interactive website, not a whole webpage. Reference image is existing white cassette player; match its blue cassette materials and pale soft upper-left illumination. Create ONE translucent pale blue compact audio cassette lying FLAT on a tabletop and photographed STRAIGHT DOWN at 90 degrees with an orthographic overhead camera. All objects in our scene share this camera. Absolutely no 3/4 yaw or perspective convergence. Horizontal and level cassette front face, 100 x 64 mm real proportions, parallel horizontal edges, vertical edges, rounded corners. Face fills approx 1120x700 centered on landscape 1536x1024 canvas. Minimal tiny perimeter thickness rim ONLY; no visible vertical side faces. Photorealistic translucent matte glossy acrylic rather than futuristic glow; pale powder blue, silver corner screws, two identical circular off-white 8-tooth reel hubs, left reel has more clean black concentric wound magnetic tape than right. Reel centers level, symmetric horizontal spacing. Empty gap between reels contains transparent clear backing, NO ribbon across gap. Accurate bottom head opening and drive holes. Blank off-white paper label across top and another below reels with enough space for real UI text. No text, symbols, letters, numbers, branding. Realistic subtle surface reflections illuminated from upper-left, restrained saturation. Transparent background with real alpha, NO checkerboard, no player, no props, no table, no tilt.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact cassette image without changing camera, silhouette, dimensions, border, screw positions, paper labels, blue acrylic color, lighting or backdrop.
Change only these parts:
1) Remove both black wound tape discs AND both white reel hubs from the central transparent window. Leave an empty continuous pale-blue clear acrylic backing, with subtle horizontal surface reflections. Do not put circles, dents or axles there; the website will add independently animated reels.
2) Remove the black player-door latch at the top center: replace it with a continuous blue acrylic top rail, matching the material on either side. This is a standalone cassette, not a player door.
3) Remove only the protruding clear player-door latch at the very bottom center below the cassette edge. Keep the accurate metallic pressure pad/head opening and drive holes above it. Make the outer bottom edge continuous like an ordinary cassette.
Preserve EVERYTHING else pixel-aligned. No text. No rotation, cropping, scale or perspective changes.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit reference desk background ONLY. Preserve the warm pale ivory subtly textured desktop, plenty of empty center and left headline area, the open blue notebook at upper right, small white memo at lower right and blue pen. This is a backdrop for separate interactive cassette/player assets.
Remove the entire cassette storage box at lower left INCLUDING its shadow and label; replace that whole region with seamless clean ivory desktop.
Correct notebook, memo and pen to a strict 90-degree orthographic TOP-DOWN camera looking straight down at one perfectly horizontal desk. Paper planes are flat with no 3/4 perspective convergence, no broad visible vertical sides; notebook only has a thin edge and subtle page curvature. Preserve their approximate sizes and locations; notebook remains clipped by top/right edges and rotated clockwise in the tabletop plane; memo remains at lower right tilted counterclockwise; pen rests along memo's right edge. Thin blue notebook binding, realistic clean paper, no writing on any paper, no UI text. Common light from upper left with short contact shadows toward lower right. No cassette tapes, no player, no box, no plant, no cup, no headphones. No added objects. Keep original 1536x1024 framing and calm pastel mood.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset: ONE empty cassette storage tray, truly straight-down orthographic TOP VIEW, for a pastel desk interactive portfolio. This is a separate object, not a website or desk scene.
Rectangular real scale 100mm x80mm footprint for five upright compact cassettes, divided into 5 long narrow parallel slots. Walls visible ONLY as thin acrylic thickness bands from directly overhead. NO visible broad vertical front panel, no side faces, no 3/4 camera, no perspective convergence. Horizontal level tray, 1250px wide x1000? fit within 1536x1024 canvas with footprint about1080x800, centered margins. Gentle rounded corners, thin clear frosted very pale blue translucent acrylic ribs and rim, realistic polymer material matching pale blue cassettes. EMPTY, no tapes, no spines. Floor visible through translucent plastic. Inside shadows strongest just beside left and top walls and dividers, brighter toward lower right. Soft upper-left light, short lower-right contact shadow. A small piece of off-white masking tape placed horizontally on BOTTOM TOP RIM, blank, about one-third tray width; do NOT attach it to a front face. This name label is seen from directly above. No writing, no UI text, no numbers. Pale ivory/transparent background, preferably real alpha. Restraint, convincing subtle acrylic reflections, no chrome, no thick walls, no outer front face.
